Pull Powers bring your foes closer to the heroes. These are useful against ranged attackers.
Dashing Powers move your hero closer to the action, and work well as lead-ins for melee combos.
Direct Damage Powers inflict harm on a target (even one who is blocking) and will disarm opponents who are holding shields.
Projectile Powers allow you to injure foes from a distance.
Radial Powers affect all foes in your immediate vicinity. They're useful when you're surrounded, or attacking a slower target.

If you're ambushed by a swarm of foes, break out a room-clearing Fusion!
Make use of the environment where possible. One exploding car can make all the difference.
When facing large numbers of foes, Powers with large areas of effect can help thin their ranks.
Don't get swarmed! Jump ($MOVE) or Dodge (left stick and $BLOCK) to a more advantageous position.
Play against enemy strengths. If you're fighting melee-based foes, use ranged attacks; if fighting ranged, use melee.
Use foes' weapons against them. If they throw a grenade, throw it back! Some heroes can also deflect projectiles with their powers.
Shielded foes can deflect most projectiles. Use your Powers with caution when facing them!
Target foes with special abilities first. They can do serious damage if you ignore them.
Pay attention to enemies' patterns. Example: foes with rocket launchers need to reload. Avoid their first shot, then strike while they're vulnerable.
Remove enemies' shields with $GUARD, Trip ($ATTACK $SMASH $ATTACK), or Direct Damage Powers.
Heavy enemies may dash at you. Jump, fly, or dodge to avoid them.
It may be helpful to avoid heavy enemies until all other foes have been dealt with. Alone, they are much easier to defeat.
Concentric rings around the feet indicate enemy Leaders. Leaders will grant bonuses to their nearby allies, so take them out first if possible.
Leaders (indicated by concentric rings) are stronger and more resilient than regular foes, but they are vulnerable to the same tactics.
Cyborgs resist grapple attacks and knockbacks. Use Trip or Stun to slow them down.
When dealing with groups of cyborgs, prioritize one and finish him off before dealing with the others.
Foes with force fields can deflect projectiles. Use melee attacks against them.
Foes with repulsion attacks can keep you from landing a punch. Use Powers on these foes.
Robots are resistant to many damage types. Choose your attacks carefully!
Watch for robots with flashing red lights. They'll attempt to explode when close to your heroes.
Large robots have numerous weapons. Keep your distance and Block or Dodge to preserve your hit points.
Explosives launched by a robot can be used against it, if you're quick. Use $GUARD to pick up objects, then tap $GUARD again to throw.
Large robots are slow. Spread your team out and lead the robot in different directions to minimize its effectiveness.
Teleporting enemies are mobile but weak. Slow them down with combos or status effects, or chase them down with distance-closer Powers.
If a foe is resisting your grab attempts, don't keep trying. Switch to Powers or melee.
Superhumans with ranged attacks are resistant to Powers similar to their own (fire to fire, ice to ice, etc.).
Nanite-infected enemies will attempt to link into local ${Q}collectives${Q}. This is indicated by a whitish color shift.
Nanite ${Q}collectives${Q} may have a Leader, indicated by concentric rings. Leaders will share powers with the entire collective, so take them out first!
When nanite minions are sharing powers, they will undergo a color shift. For example, a group of minions acquiring flame powers will turn orange.
You may encounter dormant nanite-infected foes. They are easily awoken, so make your first attack count!
Try using Fusions when encountering new enemy types. You can always regain Fusion Stars, and if you get a high score, you'll earn a Healing Token!
Nanite Leaders are identified by concentric rings around their feet. Target them first to stop them from sharing their powers!
Attack helicopters from a distance. Their close-range countermeasures will make quick work of unprepared heroes.
Against helicopters, use Dodge (left stick and tap $BLOCK) to stay agile while looking for lulls in their attacks.
Some helicopters will launch grenades. Throw them right back with $GUARD!
Targeted Fusions are your best weapon against Bosses and Mini-Bosses. Make sure to keep them in the targeting reticle.
Numbers matter. Focus on keeping your heroes alive during battles, especially with Bosses.
Bosses have special attacks that prevent your team from surrounding them.
Diversify your tactics when fighting Bosses. Try to keep a mix of melee attacks and Powers going at all times.
As a general rule, Bosses can't be grabbed, and they resist most Debuffs. Focus on dealing damage.
Bosses can take a lot of damage. Use Targeted Fusions whenever possible.
If your attacks aren't doing much damage against a foe, look for a pattern or weakness you can exploit.
When fighting Bosses, listen to your allies' advice. They'll often provide useful insight.
Damage Types: Melee - Damage suffered in hand-to-hand combat or from small thrown objects.
Damage Types: Impact - Focused damage delivered quickly, such as from martial arts strikes or extreme frequency sonics.
Damage Types: Crushing - Massive force that affects large portions of the target's body at once.
Damage Types: Wounding - Results from bullets or slashing attacks. Continues to inflict damage over time after the attack.
Damage Types: Cold - Intense and sudden drops in temperature can slow targets (indicated by a whitish tint) or even freeze them solid.
Damage Types: Electricity - High-voltage attacks will harm targets, often stunning them (coursing electricity will be visible on the target).
Damage Types: Fire - Intense heat causes damage over time after the attack (flames will be visible on the target).
Damage Types: Energy - Includes attacks such as lasers and heated plasma. May slow targets with radiation (indicated by a green tint).
Damage Types: Mental - Psychic attacks and intense sounds can stun foes (indicated by a purple tint).
Certain targets have resistances to particular damage types. A grey spark will appear when a target resists or blocks damage.
Certain characters have a chance to overcome targets' immunities. A distinctive orange spark will appear when an immunity is overcome.

After ingesting the so-called Super Soldier serum and undergoing a Vita-Ray blast, Steve Rogers became Captain America in 1941.
Captain America appeared to die during WWII. Decades later, he was found alive but trapped within a block of ice.
Matt Murdock leads a double life as a lawyer and the costumed crime-fighter Daredevil.
Eschewing publicity, Daredevil focuses on keeping the streets of New York City's Hell's Kitchen neighborhood safe.
Daredevil has worked extensively with many of New York's ${Q}street-level${Q} heroes, such as Luke Cage, Iron Fist, and Spider-Man.
Due to genetic tampering, Deadpool acquired an imperfect healing factor. His teleportation powers, however, are due to the device worn on his chest.
Despite his grim line of work, Deadpool is well-known for his offbeat sense of humor, earning the nickname ${Q}The Merc with a Mouth${Q}.
The less-than-fully-sane Deadpool has frequently expressed the belief that he is in a comic book, or occasionally, a video game.
Before Gambit was an X-Man, the so-called ${Q}Ragin' Cajun${Q} spent time as a professional thief.
Gambit uses his mutant ability to infuse ordinary playing cards with kinetic energy, then throws them with deadly precision.
Gambit's physiology is radically different from the human norm, giving him greatly increased speed and reaction time.
Driven mad by the same serum that gave him superhuman powers, Norman Osborn - AKA the Green Goblin - has plagued New York for years.
Green Goblin recently reappeared, murdering a string of innocents before being taken into custody.
With boosted physical attributes and a wide range of deadly devices, Green Goblin is a threat to anyone he perceives as an obstacle.
Bruce Banner was exposed to gamma radiation from an experimental bomb, radically altering his biology and turning him into the Hulk.
After the Hulk's last rampage, Reed Richards and Tony Stark designed the Gamma Regulators, which allow the Hulk greater self-control.
After the tragic death of his parents, Johnny Storm - AKA the Human Torch - was raised by his older sister, Susan, and later by his aunt.
Only 16 when he gained his powers, the Human Torch is the youngest member of the Fantastic Four.
Unlike many superhumans, the Human Torch basks in the fame and celebrity that comes with being a super hero.
Bobby Drake's cold-based mutant powers first manifested when he accidentally froze a school bully.
Iceman is adept at smoothing things over when tempers flare between his fellow X-Men.
After her mother's death and her father's descent into alcoholism, Susan Storm and her younger brother Johnny were taken in by their aunt.
Susan Storm crossed paths with Reed Richards several times in her youth, and eventually they began to date.
Susan Storm got her powers after a fateful test flight into outer space. Bombardment by cosmic rays turned her into the Invisible Woman.
After several years with the Fantastic Four, Susan Storm and Reed finally married. They have two children, Franklin and Valeria.
Raised in the hidden city of K'un-L'un, Daniel Rand is the wielder of the Iron Fist, a mystical energy source won in ritual combat.
Though Iron Fist is best known for his signature hard-as-iron punch, he is also able to heal others by influencing their chi flow.
Iron Fist has been a longtime ally of Luke Cage and Captain America.
An engineering genius, Tony Stark built his first suit of Iron Man armor to escape a group of international criminals.
The Iron Man armor is continually refined with the latest technology, making it one of the most sophisticated weapons on the planet.
Attempting to set an example for super heroes everywhere, Tony Stark recently went public regarding his secret identity.
A self-made billionaire, Tony Stark has access to vast resources and wields significant political clout.
A founding member of the X-Men, Jean Grey had difficulty controlling her powers when they first manifested.
With Professor X's help, Jean Grey eventually mastered her abilities, and has since become one of the most powerful mutants on Earth.
After a rough upbringing in Harlem, an experimental procedure endowed Luke Cage with his superhuman strength and resilience.
For a time Luke Cage capitalized on his abilities by founding Heroes for Hire, a business partnership he ran with Iron Fist.
Luke Cage met the super-powered Jessica Jones while tracking the Owl. He and Jessica began dating and eventually got married.
Reed Richards has the ability to distend all or part of his body at will, which he uses to great effect in and out of combat.
Though at this point in his life he's had years of combat experience, Mr. Fantastic's foremost asset is still his brilliant intellect.
Even before her career as Ms. Marvel, Carol Danvers had a distinguished record as a special agent for the government.
Ms. Marvel gained superhuman abilities after the explosion of an experimental Kree device while on assignment for the government.
Ms. Marvel has worked for a number of different organizations; most recently she has been on assignment for S.H.I.E.L.D.
Escaping a life on the streets, Songbird stepped into the limelight as a professional wrestler, and later, a super-villain.
Songbird is able to construct three-dimensional sound ${Q}shapes${Q} via her enhanced vocal cords.
Since failing to prevent the death of his uncle, Peter Parker has been driven by the need to use his powers for the common good.
Spider-Man has fought many criminals over the years, often alongside other super heroes such as the Avengers and the Fantastic Four.
Spider-Man is well-known among heroes and villains for his wisecracks, usually made during stressful situations.
Public perception of Spider-Man has mostly been negative, mainly due to the editorial slant of Daily Bugle publisher J. Jonah Jameson.
At the age of five, Ororo Munroe - AKA Storm - barely survived the plane crash which killed her parents.
Under the guidance of a tribal elder, Storm learned to control her powers, and spent several years protecting the local tribes of Kenya.
Storm was recruited by Charles Xavier to rescue the first team of X-Men, and stayed on with the team afterward.
Benjamin Grimm - AKA the Thing - had an early life of poverty and hardship, shaping him into a tough, streetwise scrapper.
Benjamin Grimm was an Air Force pilot and a NASA astronaut before the events that turned him into the Thing.
Thor is the son of the Norse god Odin and the Earth-spirit Gaea, and has been living with humankind for centuries.
Though much of his time is spent dealing with cosmic threats, Thor assists his allies on Earth when the need is dire.
Mac Gargan wears the Venom suit, an alien symbiote that grants him abilities similar to those of its first human host, Spider-Man.
Mac Gargan, the current incarnation of Venom, was formerly known as the costumed villain Scorpion.
One of the oldest mutants on record, Wolverine's memory has been tampered with on several occasions.
Wolverine's past includes time spent as a mercenary and an assassin.
Though Wolverine has worked with the X-Men for years, many in the superhuman community still do not fully trust him.
Captain America's real name is Steve Rogers.
Captain America is a master tactician and strategist, as well as an expert martial artist.
Captain America's shield is made of a vibranium alloy and can be thrown to hit multiple targets.
Daredevil's real name is Matt Murdock.
Daredevil is an experienced trial lawyer.
Daredevil has greatly heightened senses of hearing, smell, and touch, along with limited echolocation.
Deadpool's real name is Wade Wilson.
Deadpool is a master of multiple weapons and fighting styles.
Deadpool's regeneration ability is reportedly unstable, much like his mental condition.
Gambit's real name is Remy LeBeau.
Gambit's abilities include violent matter deconstruction and heightened physical attributes.
Green Goblin's real name is Norman Osborn.
Green Goblin possesses a genius-level intellect. He's an accomplished chemist and inventor.
Green Goblin's standard arsenal includes various explosives as well as a custom-built glider which obeys his mental commands.
The Hulk's real name is Bruce Banner.
The Hulk is highly damage-resistant, and his strength increases in proportion to his rage.
The Hulk currently demonstrates no powers while in human form, but holds a PhD in nuclear physics as Bruce Banner.
The Human Torch's real name is Johnny Storm.
The Human Torch can coat all or part of his body in a layer of superheated flame, which can be maintained for up to 17 hours.
The Human Torch was an experienced mechanic and race car driver before gaining his powers.
Iceman's real name is Bobby Drake.
Iceman's abilities include thermal control, allowing the creation of ice and ice constructs from ambient moisture.
Iceman's body can change into flexible ${Q}organic ice${Q}.
Invisible Woman's real name is Susan Storm Richards.
Invisible Woman has extensive experience with hand-to-hand combat due to years with the Fantastic Four.
Invisible Woman is able to render multiple subjects invisible for extended periods of time.
Invisible Woman's powers include being able to create and manipulate force fields, which have defensive and offensive applications.
Iron Fist's real name is Daniel Rand.
Iron Fist is a master of several different martial arts.
Iron Man's real name is Anthony Edward Stark.
Iron Man's technologically advanced armor is controlled by his mental command.
Iron Man's armor features tactical lasers, micro-munitions, concussive blasts, and his signature repulsor technology.
Jean Grey is a powerful telepath and telekinetic.
Jean Grey is occasionally a host to the ${Q}Phoenix Force${Q}, a cosmic entity of unmeasured power.
Luke Cage's super-dense skin and muscle tissue provides greatly enhanced strength and durability.
Mr. Fantastic's real name is Reed Richards.
Mr. Fantastic can distend himself into virtually any shape, stretch great distances, and partially adjust his density.
Ms. Marvel's real name is Carol Danvers.
Ms. Marvel's abilities include self-powered flight, energy absorption and projection, and limited contextual precognition.
Ms. Marvel was a skilled pilot and a published novelist before gaining her powers.
Songbird's real name is Melissa Gold.
Songbird's amplified sonic ${Q}screams${Q} can cause disorientation, and in some cases, tissue damage.
Songbird makes use of sonic energy to create temporary physical structures of various shape and size.
Spider-Man's real name is Peter Parker.
Spider-Man's abilities include enhanced speed, reflexes, strength, wall-crawling, and limited precognition (AKA ${Q}spider-sense${Q}).
Spider-Man has the ability to adhere to any surface. His webbing is highly adhesive and possesses extraordinary tensile strength.
Spider-Man is an accomplished chemist and physicist.
Storm's real name is Ororo Munroe.
Storm can manipulate the weather. She can generate bolts of lightning and fly via wind currents.
The Thing's real name is Benjamin Grimm.
The Thing was a trained fighter pilot before he acquired his powers.
Thor's full name is Thor Odinson.
Biologically, Thor is half-Asgardian, half-Elder God.
Thor wields several forms of divine power, including the Odinforce and the mystical hammer Mjolnir.
The Venom symbiote is currently bonded to MacDonald Gargan, who was formerly known as the Scorpion.
Venom can extend tendrils of symbiote tissue to attack or incapacitate foes.
Wolverine also goes by the name ${Q}Logan${Q}, but his real name is James Howlett.
Wolverine's abilities include a greatly accelerated healing factor, allowing for complete regrowth of destroyed organs.
Wolverine has six twelve-inch retractable adamantium claws and an adamantium-reinforced skeleton.
Wolverine has an enhanced athletic ability in addition to boosted hearing, sight, and olfactory senses.
A-Bomb's real name is Rick Jones.
In A-Bomb form, Jones gains Hulk-level strength and damage resistance but suffers from diminished intelligence.
Rick Jones is unable to control when and where he transforms into A-Bomb.
Black Panther has made his top scientists available to study Rick Jones's condition in Wakanda.
Bishop's full name is Lucas Bishop.
Bishop is a skilled marksman and hand-to-hand combatant. He has the ability to absorb energy and release it at a later time.
Bishop is a survivor from a hellish alternate future. He has assisted the X-Men on numerous occasions.
A time-traveler from a possible future, Bishop possesses firsthand knowledge of the potential dangers awaiting mutants.
Black Panther's real name is T'Challa.
Black Panther's suit utilizes a number of vibranium-based defense measures.
Black Panther is the ruler of Wakanda and has unlimited access to his country's technological and military resources.
${Q}Black Panther${Q} is a title held by the leader of Wakanda.
The current Black Panther, T'Challa, is an ex-Avenger and has fought alongside many of America's super heroes.
Black Widow's real name is Natalia Romanova, also known as Natasha Romanoff.
Black Widow possesses extensive counterintelligence training and is a skilled martial artist.
Black Widow is a Russian ex-super-spy. Since defecting to the U.S., she has conducted countless missions for S.H.I.E.L.D.
Black Widow had an extended romantic relationship with Matt Murdock, AKA Daredevil.
True to his name, Bullseye is able to throw any object with superhuman accuracy.
Bullseye has an improved resistance to physical trauma due to his adamantium-laced skeleton.
A longtime foe of Daredevil, Bullseye regularly indulges his homicidal tendencies as an assassin.
Cable's real name is Nathan Summers.
Cable's powers include telekinesis and telepathy. He is also skilled with many advanced forms of technology.
Cable is a time-traveling mutant freedom fighter. He was raised in an alternate future by Jean Grey and Scott Summers.
Cloak's real name is Tyrone Johnson.
Cloak's powers derive from a link to the mysterious Darkforce dimension.
Cloak can transport himself and others across long distances. He dispatches foes to a pitch-black, fear-inducing alternate universe.
Colossus's real name is Piotr Nikolaievitch Rasputin.
Colossus can turn his skin into flexible steel. He also possesses considerable strength even in human form.
Born on a Soviet collective farm, Colossus discovered his powers while saving his sister from an out-of-control tractor.
Colossus was recruited to the X-Men after using his powers to save his sister. Since then, he has become a mainstay of the team.
Lucia von Bardas's cybernetic body gives her greatly enhanced durability as well as the ability to fly.
As a cyborg, Lucia von Bardas is able to link into other Tinkerer-augmented super-criminals via wireless signals from implanted nanites.
Though Lucia von Bardas seemingly died during Fury's assault on Castle Doom, she came back as a cyborg to terrorize New York City.
Dagger's real name is Tandy Bowen.
Dagger creates ${Q}light daggers${Q} which have a variety of effects on the human nervous system. She is also an experienced street fighter.
Dagger's previous experience as a ballet dancer has been incorporated into her particular style of street fighting.
Diamondback's real name is Rachel Leighton.
Diamondback has had a long mercenary career. She is an expert with thrown weaponry of all sorts.
Though Diamondback doesn't possess any superhuman powers, she utilizes a number of advanced devices and is extremely dangerous.
Electro's real name is Max Dillon.
Electro is able to generate and store vast amounts of electricity. He can discharge lightning-like bolts at will.
Electro got his powers after a peculiar industrial accident, and has had numerous clashes with Spider-Man and Daredevil.
Equinox's real name is Terrance Sorenson.
Equinox underwent a radical transformation after being caught in an accidental energy discharge.
After his mother exhausted her savings attempting to cure his condition, Equinox turned to crime.
Firestar's real name is Angelica Jones.
Firestar can manipulate microwave energy, granting her flight and the generation of intense thermal blasts.
Firestar has served on a number of super hero teams, though she is best known for her time with the New Warriors.
Goliath's real name is Bill Foster.
Goliath is able to grow to incredible heights via use of Pym particles.
Goliath is an experienced biochemist. He worked with Hank Pym on numerous laboratory projects in the past.
Goliath used to go by the name Giant Man.
Grim Reaper's real name is Eric Williams.
In place of his right hand, Grim Reaper has a mechanical scythe which can emit anesthetic gas and energy rays.
Brother of the Avenger Wonder Man, Eric Williams - AKA Grim Reaper - left the family business for life as a career criminal.
Havok's real name is Alexander Summers.
Havok and Cyclops are brothers. They were separated from each other at a young age.
Havok did not come into contact with the X-Men until well into adulthood. Since meeting the team he has worked with them numerous times.
Hercules' original Greek name was Heracles.
Hercules possesses superhuman strength and resilience, and is immune to the aging process.
Hercules wields the Golden Mace, an enchanted weapon forged by Hephaestus.
Hercules is one of several immortals who have left Mount Olympus to live among humans.
Jessica Jones had a short-lived super hero career as ${Q}Jewel${Q} (and later, ${Q}Knightress${Q}).
After Jessica Jones retired from super heroics, her experience came in handy when she started her own private detective agency.
Jessica Jones and Luke Cage are married, and she recently gave birth to their first child.
Justice's real name is Vance Astrovik.
Justice is able to manifest his telekinetic powers in a number of ways, including concussive blasts and impenetrable force fields.
Justice (formerly ${Q}Marvel Boy${Q}) is a powerful telekinetic and a founding member of the New Warriors.
Lady Deathstrike's real name is Yuriko Oyama.
Lady Deathstrike is a skilled pilot and martial artist.
Lady Deathstrike has an adamantium-treated skeleton and ten twelve-inch telescoping adamantium claws.
Lady Deathstrike's father invented the process used to bond adamantium to Wolverine's skeleton.
Lucia von Bardas is an experienced diplomat and former university professor.
After Doctor Doom's apparent death, the U.S. government helped install Lucia von Bardas as Latveria's president.
Lucia von Bardas has secretly funded a number of tech-based villains, using Latveria's own resources as well as American aid money.
Maria Hill is now Acting Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
Maria Hill was chosen to replace Nick Fury partially due to her lack of loyalty to the former S.H.I.E.L.D. Director.
Molten Man's real name is Mark Raxton.
Molten Man's soft tissues have been converted to frictionless liquid metal. He is capable of radiating intense heat and energy.
Molten Man has a college degree and is qualified as a chemical engineer.
Though Molten Man reportedly reformed at one point, he has recently returned to a life of crime.
Moonstone's real name is Karla Sofen.
Moonstone possesses an extraterrestrial gem that grants flight, at-will intangibility, and gravity manipulation.
Moonstone was a brilliant psychologist who manipulated one of her patients into giving her an alien gem, which grants her a number of powers.
Multiple Man's real name is Jamie Madrox.
Multiple Man is capable of creating up to forty organic duplicates of himself, each capable of independent thought and action.
Multiple Man has worked with various teams, most recently forming the X-Factor Investigations Company.
Namorita's full name was Namorita Prentiss.
Namorita was an Atlantean. As such her physiology granted flight, as well as strength, speed, and durability far above human norms.
Namorita was an Atlantean royal. She was also a founding member of the New Warriors, even leading the team for a time.
Nick Fury's full name is Nicholas Joseph Fury.

Nick Fury benefits from a chemically-slowed aging process thanks to the ${Q}Infinity Formula${Q}.
Nick Fury is the son of a decorated WWI pilot. Fury entered the armed services after a brief career in air shows.
Hold $BLOCK to block. Blocking protects heroes from most attacks, but they are still vulnerable to grabs, direct damage attacks, and dashing attacks.
Nick Fury lost his left eye in a fight with his brother, who had defected to the criminal organization HYDRA.
After being prevented from destroying Prison 42, Nick Fury was forcibly absorbed into the Fold's hive consciousness.
S.H.I.E.L.D. Life Model Decoys (LMDs) are advanced robotic devices designed to masquerade as key S.H.I.E.L.D. personnel.
Nitro's real name is Robert Hunter.
Nitro is capable of exploding with great force and then re-forming at a later time.
Nitro was a certified electrical engineer.
Endowed with his explosive powers by alien Kree, Nitro is a long-running foe of Captain Marvel (Mar-Vell).
Patriot's real name is Elijah Bradley.
Patriot is proficient at using his shield as a weapon in addition to his signature five-pointed throwing stars.
Elijah Bradley, AKA Patriot, is the grandson of Project: Rebirth hero Isaiah Bradley.
After receiving a derivative of the Super Soldier serum, Patriot developed partial invulnerability and Olympic-level athleticism.
Prodigy's real name is Ritchie Gilmore.
Prodigy is a skilled wrestler, which he is able to use to great effect while in his suit.
Prodigy was a high school athlete but yearned to become something more. He leapt at the chance when offered the Prodigy suit.
Prodigy's career has been checkered by fallen teammates and a less-than-heroic attitude toward his fellow man.
Scorcher's real name is Steven Hudak.
Scorcher's suit is capable of projecting superheated fire over a large area. He can also attain limited flight via jetpack.
A research chemist turned criminal, Scorcher constructed the first iteration of his suit in a misguided attempt at revenge.
Over the years Scorcher has been foiled by a number of heroes, most notably Spider-Man and Daredevil.
New York's Senator Lieber is beloved by citizens around the world. His supporters have even been dubbed ${Q}True Believers${Q}.
Senator Lieber is often found at comic book conventions, and frequently pushes civilians out of the path of falling objects.
Senator Lieber's full name is Stanley M. Lieber.
She-Hulk's real name is Jennifer Susan Walters.
She-Hulk can transform at will into ${Q}Hulk${Q} form. Unlike Bruce Banner, she retains her human intellect while in this state.
She-Hulk is a skilled attorney, currently working for a law firm specializing in metahuman case law.
An emergency blood transfusion from her cousin Bruce Banner turned Jennifer Walters into the She-Hulk.
So far She-Hulk has successfully juggled a civilian law career and part-time membership in the Avengers.
Shocker's real name is Herman Schultz.
After a mediocre criminal career, Herman Schultz - AKA Shocker - built the first incarnation of his vibro units in a prison workshop.
Over the years Shocker has hired himself out as an assassin and high-level enforcer, though he usually returns to simple theft.
Speedball's real name is Robbie Baldwin.
Speedball got his powers from a freak accident in a Connecticut lab. The explosion also conferred similar powers to a nearby cat.
Speedball is a founding member of the New Warriors. He has gained a clownish reputation despite his frequent heroics.
Spider-Woman's real name is Jessica Drew.
Jessica Drew, AKA Spider-Woman, has played many roles in her life: spy, black-ops agent, super hero.
Spider-Woman was one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s most valuable agents and is a key member of the New Avengers.
Spider-Woman has had a long history of being manipulated, including years as a brainwashed HYDRA agent.
Tinkerer's real name is Phineas Mason.
Tinkerer is a mechanical genius specializing in exotic weaponry and human augmentation systems.
The Tinkerer entered into a partnership with Lucia von Bardas after the death of his son.
While several individuals have worn versions of the Titanium Man armor, the identity of its current occupant is unknown.
Titanium Man's armor is equipped with a number of high-tech weapons systems, including a sophisticated cloaking device.
War Machine's real name is James Rhodes.
War Machine wears modified Starktech armor with numerous weapons systems, including tactical missiles and a micro-munitions cannon.
Jim Rhodes, AKA War Machine, worked as Tony Stark's personal pilot, later filling in as Iron Man for a time.
Whirlwind's real name is David Cannon.
Whirlwind has clashed frequently with the Avengers, and has become obsessed with revenge against the super hero community.
Aside from high-speed melee attacks, Whirlwind is able to manipulate air currents to attack his foes from afar.
Wizard's real name is Bentley Wittman.
Wizard is an accomplished scientist in multiple fields and an independent businessman.
Bentley Wittman, AKA the Wingless Wizard, has had many clashes with the Fantastic Four.
A mechanical genius and self-made millionaire, Wizard turned to super-villainy out of boredom.
Over the years Wizard's been responsible for many incarnations of the Frightful Four.
Wonder Man's real name is Simon Williams.
Wonder Man's ${Q}ionic body${Q} gives him self-powered flight, energy projection, superhuman strength and durability.
Initially created by Baron Zemo as a weapon against the Avengers, Wonder Man eventually broke free of the villain's control.
Wonder Man has helped the Avengers numerous times over the years, though he has also spent time as an actor.
Yellowjacket's real name is Henry ${Q}Hank${Q} Pym.
Yellowjacket is an accomplished scientist with specialties in biochemistry, physics, robotics, and cybernetics.
Yellowjacket is able to shrink or grow by manipulating his mass via his patented ${Q}Pym Particles${Q}.
Though Yellowjacket has aided the Avengers countless times, his mental instability makes him a danger to himself and others.
Captain America's hideout is believed to be located somewhere in New York City.
Captain America's hideout is assumed to have hardened military defenses and various recon countermeasures.
Intel suggests Captain America has at least one well-equipped headquarters from which he could command an extended guerilla campaign.
It is suspected that Captain America is receiving funds from the Rand Corporation, but this is hotly contested by their accounting staff.
Geffen-Meyer Chemical owns a relatively outdated plant in New Jersey's notoriously dirty industrial complex.
The Geffen-Meyer Chemical Plant has been barely profitable for over a decade and is rumored to be slated for closure.
Geffen-Meyer maintains a number of facilities spread across the Northeast, including a chemical plant in New Jersey.
Doctor Doom's real name is Victor von Doom. He is believed to be deceased.
As monarch of Latveria, Doctor Doom had unlimited access to the country's resources, which he tried to use to seize ever-greater power.
A scientific genius, Dr. Doom constructed an advanced suit of powered armor, as well as multiple robotic duplicates.
Doctor Doom supplemented his technical prowess with sorcery, a skill passed on from his mother and increased through his own research.
Doctor Doom disappeared during his last confrontation with the world's super heroes; sources claim otherworldly forces were involved.
Nick Fury's base is a hardened military bunker, self-powered and passively shielded from a wide range of detection measures.
Nick Fury's base contains a suite of reconnaissance equipment, an LMD repair bay, and limited laboratory facilities.
There are a number of super-secret S.H.I.E.L.D. bases scattered around the globe. Several are known only to Nick Fury.
HYDRA is a secret terror organization bent on world domination.
HYDRA members are known for their bright green uniforms, and their oft-repeated rallying cry, ${Q}Hail HYDRA!${Q}
HYDRA was formed in the 1940s by Baron Wolfgang von Strucker and has endured for decades.
HYDRA relies on raw numbers of soldiers supplemented by technology, allowing bases to be brought up and running seemingly overnight.
Latveria is a landlocked country in the Carpathian Basin. It shares a border with Hungary, Transylvania, and Symkaria, among others.
Latveria was conquered by Doctor Doom in 1940. Though the largely rural nation prospered under his reign, Doom was a tyrannical ruler.
Doctor Doom mysteriously disappeared several years ago and shortly thereafter Lucia von Bardas was elected to the throne.
Latverian cyborgs were one of Latveria's most closely guarded secrets. Their existence is a violation of multiple international treaties.
Each Latverian cyborg's equipment matches a tech-based super-criminal template, modified for mass production.
Only the most fanatically loyal Latverian soldiers are selected to undergo the conversation procedures and become cyborgs.
Latverian soldiers are the mainstay of the country's defense forces.
The standard Latverian soldier carries an advanced stun baton that causes bioelectric feedback in anyone it strikes.
Latverian soldiers make use of traditional firearms such as machine guns and rocket-propelled grenades.
International mercenaries often have guerilla training and utilize various black-market weaponry.
International mercenaries hire themselves out to the highest bidder, undertaking missions of violence on behalf of unknown sponsors.
A key Fold base is located in a mountainous region of Iceland.
Use of nanite ${Q}protoswarms${Q} has enabled the Fold base's extremely rapid construction.
The Fold's Iceland-based repeater tower transmits control signals between North America and Europe.
Discovered by Mr. Fantastic, the Negative Zone is a dimensional space where all matter has a negative charge.
Prolonged exposure to the Negative Zone can have deleterious effects on human psychology and biology.
The Negative Zone is a subspace dimension that has been partially explored by the Fantastic Four.
New York City has five boroughs: Brooklyn, the Bronx, Queens, Staten Island, and Manhattan.
Founded in 1624 by Dutch traders, New York City occupies over three hundred square miles and is home to eight million residents.
New York City has had difficulties with numerous threats, including alien invasions, renegade robots, and the occasional sentient building.
Prison 42 is situated in a previously unmapped region of the Negative Zone.
Access to Prison 42 is limited to a single transdimensional portal situated below Ryker's Island prison.
Prison 42's name comes from its place on a list of 100 ideas for a safer world, as conceived by Reed Richards and Tony Stark.
Prison 42 uses the most advanced technology available, and is designed to be absolutely escape-proof.
The rebel hideout in Jersey City was once a HYDRA base, but it has been refurbished for operations against S.H.I.E.L.D.
The Anti-Reg hideout in Jersey City was built with a hardened construction, including multiple titanium blast doors.
The Anti-Reg base in Jersey City has internal and external defense systems. It is designed to operate in isolation for months.
The SRA requires all superhumans to register with the government, as well as provide information on their civilian identities.
The SRA compels S.H.I.E.L.D. to take registered superhumans onto the government payroll and train them as law enforcement personnel.
The Superhuman Registration Act authorizes S.H.I.E.L.D. to arrest any superhumans who refuse to register.
Critics fear the Superhuman Registration Act will make super heroes vulnerable to political influence.
Though the super hero registration database is secure, if it were hacked into, personal information about registered heroes could be exposed.
Ryker's Island is situated between Queens and the Bronx and is approximately half the size of Central Park.
A facility housing hardened criminals both human and superhuman, Ryker's Island has a long history dating back to the late 1800s.
S.H.I.E.L.D. maintains a presence at Ryker's Island.
S.H.I.E.L.D. stands for Strategic Hazard Intervention Espionage Logistics Directorate.
Formed to combat the terrorist group HYDRA, S.H.I.E.L.D. is one of the most sophisticated organizations on the planet.
Over the years S.H.I.E.L.D. has become a watchdog for superhuman threats.
As the only organization equipped to deal with super-villains, it falls to S.H.I.E.L.D. to save the world when super heroes can't.
S.H.I.E.L.D. agents have had extensive training in armed combat, police procedures, and specialized anti-superhuman countermeasures.
The best of the best, members of S.H.I.E.L.D. are the government's answer to super-powered problems.
Debate rages over whether S.H.I.E.L.D. has too much - or too little - power in the world.
S.H.I.E.L.D. Capekillers have advanced weaponry and armor systems with customized loadouts for each op.
S.H.I.E.L.D.'s elite ${Q}Capekillers${Q} are tasked with taking down the most powerful resistors of the Registration Act.
Capekillers are equipped with heavy weaponry and bleeding-edge tech, and represent a threat to even the mightiest superhumans.
The S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier was designed by Tony Stark, Reed Richards, and the X-Man named Forge.
The Helicarrier is a massive airship which acts as a base of operations for S.H.I.E.L.D.
The S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier is constantly on the move and utilizes a number of advanced stealth technologies
S.H.I.E.L.D. Life Model Decoys (LMDs) are advanced robotic devices designed to masquerade as key S.H.I.E.L.D. personnel.
S.H.I.E.L.D. Life Model Decoys (LMDs) emulate human speech, thought patterns, and personal habits with a high degree of accuracy.
Life Model Decoys have contributed to S.H.I.E.L.D.'s success over the years, enabling important work in in high-risk areas.
Life Model Decoys (LMDs) pose a significant risk, as a compromised person could be replaced for some time before being detected.
Though capable of acting autonomously, S.H.I.E.L.D. Life Model Decoys (LMDs) are usually piloted from a secure location.
S.H.I.E.L.D. nanites allow for complete remote control of any humanoid with a traditional nervous system.
S.H.I.E.L.D. nanites are hard-wired with emergency shutdown protocols in case of emergency.
Based on technology originated by the Tinkerer, Reed Richards engineered a strain of nanites that could control human behavior.
After introduction into a subject's bloodstream, the nanites seek out key structures in the nervous system and adhere to them.
S.H.I.E.L.D. Nanite Control Officers undergo specialized training relating to the deployment of nanite-controlled super-villains.
For public relations purposes, each S.H.I.E.L.D. Nanite Control Officer must complete a one-week course on bioethics.
Stamford is a small city located on the southern coast of Connecticut.
Stamford, Connecticut was the site of the infamous New Warriors disaster. Television cameras captured the explosion which killed over 600 civilians.
Stamford, Connecticut was where Nitro exploded, killing most of the New Warriors and hundreds of innocent men, women, and children.
Stark Tower's construction was completed in just under four years. Its top three floors are reserved for super hero use.
Tony Stark lives in Stark Tower's penthouse. The building also contains facilities for the modification of his Iron Man armor.
Though the public focuses on ${Q}named${Q} super-villains, street-level metahuman crime has been on the rise for years.
In the past, most super-powered crime-fighting was conducted by vigilantes who did not have the resources to incarcerate their foes.
Conventional law enforcement is now better equipped to deal with superhuman threats, yielding an influx of super-powered prison inmates.
The Fold originated from the neural net operating between nanite-controlled villains.
The Fold's nanite hosts are capable of forming local ${Q}collectives${Q} to share metahuman abilities.
The Fold utilizes nanite ${Q}protoswarms${Q} for support tasks, such as construction.
The Fold's ${Q}protoswarms${Q} do not appear capable of complex decision-making, but rather serve as automated tools for the collective.
S.H.I.E.L.D.'s nanite control program had an unexpected side effect: the birth of the Fold, a self-aware entity controlling its ${Q}hosts${Q}.
Vibranium absorbs nearby vibrations and kinetic energy. It is believed to be extraterrestrial in origin.
Many heroes make use of objects incorporating vibranium. For example, Captain America's shield is made of a vibranium alloy.
The largest naturally occurring deposits of vibranium are in the nation of Wakanda.
Wakanda is one of the most technologically sophisticated nations in the world.
Wakanda's current leader, T'Challa - AKA the Black Panther - maintains friendly relations with many of the world's super heroes.
Members of the Wakandan Royal Guard favor traditional weapons, but all members of the Guard are highly skilled in modern warfare.
Trained from youth, the Royal Guard of Wakanda have dedicated their lives to the protection of the Wakanda's royal family.
Washington, D.C. is the capital city of the United States, located between Maryland and Virginia.
Though the Superhuman Registration Act is controversial for many reasons, none dispute that super hero violence is at an all-time high.
S.H.I.E.L.D. agents who broke rank to join Captain America dubbed themselves the White Star.
Though White Star doesn't have S.H.I.E.L.D.'s extensive resources, their military training makes them dangerous opponents.
Fold teleporter pods have vibranium-laced outer shells that absorb kinetic energy, protecting the pods' delicate inner workings.
Fold teleporter pods allow the Fold to rapidly disperse their ground assault forces.
Unlike traditional troop transit solutions, Fold teleporter pods can be launched into enemy territory, much like a conventional warhead.
